title: Kargo
description:
Kargo is a 2D cave-flyer with a focus on puzzle elements. Your goal is to deliver cargo containers to their designated targets. Navigate your spaceship through challenging levels with Asteroids-like controls. Gates, cannons and other level elements are color-coded and activate when the corresponding cargo item is present. Figure out the right order in which to...Collect containers to open gatesAvoid bullets and other obstaclesAnd above all: Deliver your cargo

Kargo is heavily inspired by classics such as Crazy Gravity and similar cave-flyers. However, its unique combination of puzzle solving, precision flying and shooting cargo, along with modern controller support, provides a fresh experience into the genre.

The game was designed for small screen sizes and controllers, so it's best played on the Steam Deck (or similar handheld consoles).
description_short: Collect containers with your spaceship to activate color-coded gates, navigate through challenging levels as fast as possible and deliver your cargo. Experience a unique combination of puzzle solving, precision cave-flying and cargo shooting.
